description: List the layernote project's comments, newest first: by default the open ones (status OPEN, IN_PROGRESS or IN_REVIEW). Each has its text, author, date, assignee, due date, board column, thread and where it is: on a live page (URL and CSS selectors) or on an uploaded file (file id and name, pin in percent, PDF page or video moment). Comparison-generated items carry an expected/actual analysis. Narrow it with the filters, e.g. one file, or `since` for what happened in a week (that includes resolved ones). Use get_feedback for one item with its screenshot, get_file to see a file with its pins.

assignee.description: Only items assigned to this person (part of their name or email), or "none"

author.description: Only items written by this person (part of their name or email)

file.description: Only comments on this uploaded file: its id from list_files, or part of its name (every file it matches)

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

since.description: Only items made, changed, resolved or replied to since then: an ISO date like 2026-10-08. Includes resolved items unless includeResolved is false

name: list_feedback
title: List feedback
